extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, regulated entities, and agency staff who submit comments, attend agency meetings, or respond to Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) notices
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the substantive requirements and procedural elements that federal agencies must include in Federal Register notices (e.g., self-evaluation notices, PRA submissions, meeting notices, application docketing) and the expectations for public participation and agency handling of comments/records.

rubrics_metrics.name: OSC self-evaluation requirement (5 CFR 1850.10(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires OSC to evaluate its current policies and practices and the effects thereof in order to determine if they result in discrimination against handicapped persons in employment, program accessibility, communication, or otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the substantive duty under the OSC regulation on Enforcement of Nondiscrimination on the Basis of Handicap in Programs or Activities Conducted By OSC (5 CFR part 1850). The notice announces the self-evaluation and frames the issues to be examined (employment, accessibility, communication).

rubrics_metrics.name: OSC participation obligation (5 CFR 1850.10(b))
rubrics_metrics.description: OSC must provide an opportunity to interested persons, including individuals with handicaps or organizations representing individuals with handicaps, to participate in the self-evaluation process by submitting comments (both oral and written).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice gives explicit channels and deadlines for participation: a written comment deadline (comments must be received by February 5, 1990), mailing address for written comments, and a telephone number for oral comments. It also notes that comments will be available for public inspection in the OSC Management Division between 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m.

rubrics_metrics.name: OSC follow-up, corrective action, and records retention
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon completion of the self-evaluation and comment period, OSC will carefully review all comments, take appropriate steps to correct deficiencies in its programs and activities, and maintain on file areas examined, any problems identified and any modifications made for a period of three years following completion of the self-evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The file will be made available for public inspection upon request. This sets expectations for agency follow-through, transparency, and record retention for the self-evaluation project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) submission elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Public information collection requirement notices submitted to OMB must summarize: Type of request (e.g., reinstatement, extension), Originating office, Title of information collection, Form number, Frequency, Respondents, Estimated number of respondents, Average hours per response, and Total estimated burden hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices typically include availability of copies of the proposed form/supporting documents and provide contact information for the agency clearance officer and the OMB reviewer to whom comments/questions should be directed. Example: 'Comments and questions should be directed to (OMB) Don Arbuckle (202) 395–7340.'

rubrics_metrics.name: PRA notice contact and comment process
rubrics_metrics.description: PRA notices must state where copies of forms/supporting documents may be obtained and to whom (and where) comments or questions should be directed (agency clearance officer and OMB reviewer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice includes named contacts, telephone numbers, and addresses for obtaining forms and submitting comments; e.g., 'Copies of the proposed form and supporting documents may be obtained from Gail J. Cook (202) 647-3538.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting notice 15‑day advance notice explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: When the statutory/agency requirement for 15-day advance notice of a meeting is not met, the Federal Register notice should explain the reason the requirement was not met (e.g., 'delays within the Department of State in receiving meeting information', 'difficulties in establishing the agenda and meeting location').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice should explicitly state the cause for the short notice so the public understands why advanced notice was not provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public attendance and participation conditions for agency meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices must specify whether members of the general public may attend and participate and any conditions: attendance subject to available seating, instructions of the Chairman, pre-registration requirements, building security/escort arrangements, and specified entrance points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Members of the general public may attend and participate in the meeting, subject to available seating and the instructions of the Chairman.' 'Requests for further information should be directed to the Chairman' and 'persons who plan to attend should telephone ... to pre-register and arrange for entry into the State Department.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting agenda and purpose content
rubrics_metrics.description: Meeting notices must include the agenda and the purposes of the meeting (e.g., approval of minutes, reports, review of prior meetings, identification of priorities, drafting positions for international assemblies, other business).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice should list specific agenda items and the meeting's goals so the public knows what will be discussed (e.g., WG reports, document approvals, preparation for CCIR Plenary Assembly, WARC-92 preparation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Docketed applications (DOT Subpart Q) notice elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices of applications for certificates of public convenience and necessity and foreign air carrier permits must include: docket number, date filed, due date for answers/conforming applications or motions to modify scope, and a description of the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice must also state post-answer processing: 'Following the answer period DOT may process the application by expedited procedures. Such procedures may consist of the adoption of a show-cause order, a tentative order, or in appropriate cases a final order without further proceedings.'

rubrics_metrics.name: RTCA and similar advisory committee meeting public statement rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices should state that attendance is open to the interested public (limited to space available), that with the Chairman's approval members of the public may present oral statements, and that any member of the public may present written statements to the committee at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices provide contact information (secretariat) for persons wishing to present statements or obtain information. Example phrasing: 'With the approval of the Chairman, members of the public may present oral statements at the meeting. Any member of the public may present a written statement to the committee at any time.'

rubrics_metrics.name: PRA burden-estimate detail and breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: PRA notices should provide numeric estimates for respondents and burdens: estimated number of respondents/recordkeepers, estimated burden hours per response/recordkeeper, frequency of response, and estimated total reporting/recordkeeping burden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some notices include further breakdowns of time (e.g., Form 970: recordkeeping 8 hrs. 22 min.; learning about the law 1 hr. 12 min.; preparing and sending the form 1 hr. 23 min.). Include name and contact of the clearance officer and OMB reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sunshine Act meeting notice requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices under the Government in the Sunshine Act must include a contact person for additional information, date/time/place of the meeting, the status (open/closed), matters to be considered, and where to call for recorded agenda information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example elements: contact person name/address/phone, statement of matters to be considered (e.g., Enforcement Matter OS # 4666), and a recorded-message telephone number for the latest agenda information.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH advisory committee meeting notice requirements (Recombinant DNA Advisory Committee)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices must state statutory authority (Public Law 92-463), time/date/location, that the meeting is open to the public, topics to be discussed (e.g., proposed major actions; amendment of NIH Guidelines; proposals to seek community views; interim reports on experiments), and that attendance is limited to space available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice should explain public speaking rules (opportunity at discretion of the Chair), provide a contact for materials/rosters/substantive information, and state that a summary of the meeting will be available later. If program listings (CFDA) are extensive or impractical, explain and provide an information contact for questions.
